GRR.headline: Heavy rain possible Tue with slow front; gales on Lake Michigan

areas.label: Heavy rain with slow-moving front
areas.quote: Precipitable water surges close 2 inches, so heavy rain potential is there as the front will be moving slowly and MBE vectors are less than 5 knots.

areas.label: South gales, small craft advisory
areas.quote: After a brief lull, winds and waves will increase again on Monday night and Tuesday when south gales are expected.

areas.label: Upper 30s northern interior
areas.quote: With the surface high building in tonight, radiational cooling conditions will be optimized and temperatures will fall into the 40s in most places, with even upper 30s possible across the northern interior.

DTX.headline: Small craft advisories today; gales possible Tuesday, storms return

areas.label: Small craft advisory, 25-30 kt winds
areas.quote: Small craft advisories have been issued for all nearshore waters later this afternoon through tonight for a combination of wind gusts in excess of 25 knots and/or 3+ foot waves.

areas.label: Possible 35-40 kt gales, Lake Huron
areas.quote: However, blended ensemble guidance show a strong signal for 35-40 kt gales peaking Tuesday morning over the open water of Lake Huron.

areas.label: Storms, training heavy rain
areas.quote: There are plenty of details that will be refined as we get closer, but Tuesday through late next week currently feature numerous chances for showers and thunderstorms, including the potential for training precipitation.

areas.label: Gales possible near Lake Michigan
areas.quote:
Current sounding-derived probs suggest a 30-40 percent 
(medium confidence) chance of wind gusts in excess of 34kts, 
particularly at sites near Lake MI (and perhaps up toward DeTour and 
Drummond Island) where there is better fetch off the effectively 
frictionless lake surface on S to SW flow

areas.label: Chilly night, mid 30s interior
areas.quote:
Have trended lows a little cooler for tonight 
especially across the interior higher terrain, down into the upper 
30s there...where a 25 degree temperature swing would take lows 
tonight down into the mid thirties.

MQT.headline: Frost in interior west tonight; soaking rain and gales Monday night into Tuesday

areas.label: Frost, lows in the 20s-30s
areas.quote:
Chilly tonight with frost in the interior west. Frost Advisory
  in effect for Gogebic, Iron, and Baraga counties.

areas.label: Dangerous swimming, Alger shoreline
areas.quote:
Dangerous swimming conditions persist along the Alger County
  shoreline today.

areas.label: Soaking 1"+ rain, UP-wide
areas.quote:
Widespread rain moves into the UP from west to east late
  Monday into Monday night, ending Tuesday morning.

areas.label: Gales on Lake Superior, Lake Michigan
areas.quote:
A Gale Watch has been issued for southerly gales followed by
  westerly gales over the Upper Great Lakes Monday evening
  through Tuesday.
